title: The Trap at Ganlu Temple Becomes a Wedding
summary: Zhou Yu's plan is to offer Sun Quan's sister to the widowed Liu Bei, hold him in Wu as a hostage-son-in-law, and trade him back for Jing province. Zhuge Liang sends him anyway with three sealed bags of instructions and Zhao Yun to open them.

Liu Bei charms the Dowager, who inspects him at Ganlu Temple and likes what she sees, and the sham marriage becomes a real one over Zhou Yu's objections. The bride keeps a hundred armed maids in her bedchamber.
history: The marriage is historical and so is Lady Sun's armed household, which the sources say frightened Liu Bei considerably.

pins.note: Walks into the trap and marries out of it.
Keeps a hundred armed maids in her rooms.
